title: Master Data Management Analyst
description:
*About the Digital Data Team*

We are an innovative global healthcare company, driven by one purpose: we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives. Our team, across some 100 countries, is dedicated to transforming the practice of medicine by working to turn the impossible into the possible. We provide potentially life-changing treatment options and life-saving vaccine protection to millions of people globally, while putting sustainability and social responsibility at the center of our ambitions.

  

Sanofi’s Digital Data organization’s mission is to transform Sanofi into a data-first and AI first organization by empowering everyone with good data. Through custom developed products built on world class data foundations and platforms, the team builds value and a unique competitive advantage that scales across our markets, R&D, and manufacturing sites. The team is in major hubs in Paris, Lyon, Barcelona, Cambridge, Bridgewater and most recently, Toronto, with the aim of opening a new office in Hyderabad. Join a dynamic, fast paced, and talented team, with world class mentorship, using AI and ML to chase the miracle of science.

*About Growing with Us:*

**In this role you will** play a crucial role in ensuring the accuracy, consistency, and integrity of our organization's data assets. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to design, implement, and maintain data management solutions that drive informed decision-making, improve operational efficiency, and increase business values. This will be achieved by the **following:**

* Collaborate with key stakeholders, MDM specialists, and IT (Information Technology) teams to understand master data management (MDM) platform requirements, quality standards, and integration needs.
* Design and implement MDM platform capabilities to ensure master data ingress / egress, accuracy, consistency, and compliance with established standards.
* Maintain legacy and upcoming MDM platforms at Sanofi including but not limited to Semarchy, Informatica, AWS, Oracle RDS, MS SQL Server and JSON APIs.
* Conduct support operations for AWS account management, GitHub, Redis and other platforms
* Manage and optimize data integration processes using tools to ensure seamless data flow between various systems and platforms.
* Perform data profiling, validation, and cleansing to identify and rectify data quality issues.
* Create and maintain documentation for MDM platforms
* Participate in data migration projects, ensuring successful data transfers between different systems and platforms.
* Collaborate with DevOps teams to implement data pipelines, automate data workflows, and ensure continuous integration and deployment.
* Utilize programming skills in Python for data manipulation and transformation tasks.
* Monitor data quality and performance, proactively identifying and addressing issues to ensure optimal data management.
* Excellent communication skills
* Stay up to date with industry trends and emerging technologies related to master data management, cloud computing, and data integration.

*About you*

*Key Functional Requirements & Qualifications:*

* Solid understanding of data management principles, data governance, and data quality best practices.
* Proficiency in designing, developing, and maintaining data integration workflows
* Prior experience in data migration and data governance projects is desirable.
* Familiarity with DevOps practices and tools, enabling seamless integration and deployment of data solutions.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a keen eye for identifying data anomalies and quality issues.
* Excellent communication skills to collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Proven ability to work independently and as part of a cross-functional team in a fast-paced environment. Flexibility in learning and adopting new technologies, frameworks and platforms.
* Relevant certifications in data management, cloud computing, or related fields are a plus.

*Key Technical Requirements & Qualifications:*

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, or any other related fields. (Advanced degree preferred).
* 5+ years of hands-on experience working with Informatica, Semarchy, MS SQL Server, Oracle, Postgres, and Python.
* Experience with cloud-based technologies, especially AWS services for account management, key rotation, data storage, processing, and analytics.

*When joining our team, you will experience:*

* An international work environment, in which you can develop your talent and realize ideas and innovations within a competent team
* An attractive, market-oriented salary and cafeteria benefits
* Flexible home office policy, with a possibility to work up to 60% of time from home / where you can easily schedule your office days
* Work from an "Office of the Year 2020" finalist office
* Collective life and accident insurance
* Yearly medical check-up
* Exposure to training and certification pathways for technical and functional skills from AWS, Snowflake, Informatica and others
* An individual and well-structured introduction and training of new employees and we will dedicate a Buddy for you to better navigate in your first weeks
* Your own career path within Sanofi. Your professional and personal development will be supported purposefully
* Join a great community & unique events (Monthly Board Game Nights, Summer Events, Well-Being Lectures & Sport Clubs)

*Pursue Progress, discover Extraordinary*

Better is out there. Better medications, better outcomes, better science. But progress does not happen without people – people from diverse backgrounds, in various locations, doing distinct roles, all united by one thing: a desire to make miracles happen. So, let us be those people.
  
  
At Sanofi, we provide equal opportunities to all regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or gender identity
  
  
#Sanofi #WeNeverSettle #SanofiCareers #PursueProgress #DiscoverExtraordinary #joinsanofi #careerswithpurpose #LI-EUR

We recognize to truly tap into the richness diversity brings we must lead with inclusion and have a workplace where those differences can thrive and be leveraged to empower the lives of our colleagues, patients, and customers. We respect and celebrate the diversity of our people, their backgrounds and experiences and provide equal opportunity for all.

description:
**Job Title : Computer Vision (Video Analytics) Dev**

**Location: Kondapur HYD**

**Experience: 3-5 years**

**Role SUMMARY**

Own the end-to-end technical architecture of the platform — from IP67 edge camera capture through computer vision inference to the SaaS dashboards used by kitchen operators, aggregators, and FSSAI regulators. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who has already taken at least 2–3 video analytics products from zero to production, ideally in kitchen, utility, or industrial/environmental-safety domains where wastage, hygiene, and safety KPIs were the core deliverable.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* **Architecture ownership —** design the full edge-to-cloud pipeline: IP67 camera capture, RTSP ingestion, edge inference nodes, MQTT-based event orchestration, and the cloud aggregation and dashboard layer.
* **SaaS platform —** direct development of the web application across both frontend and backend, covering the operator dashboard, aggregator API layer, and FSSAI regulator view.
* **MLOps & model lifecycle —** own model versioning, CI/CD for model deployment, automated retraining pipelines, and continuous production monitoring for drift, accuracy decay, and latency.
* **KPI pipelines —** define and enforce data-pipeline standards for hygiene, wastage, and environmental-safety KPIs (PPE compliance, cross-contamination, spill/pest detection, portion variance, storage segregation).
* **Performance & reliability —** set and hold the team to technical SLAs such as sub-2-second inference latency and 99.9% system uptime.
* **Cloud & DevOps —** evaluate and implement AWS or GCP infrastructure for secure, multi-tenant deployment across hundreds of outlets; build containerization, CI/CD, and observability practices.
* **Team leadership —** lead and mentor the Data Scientist and the three interns; run technical reviews and unblock delivery.
* **Compliance by design —** ensure the architecture meets DPDP Act 2023 and FSSAI requirements, including edge-anonymization of facial data for the Smilometer/Trust Score modules.
* **Founder support —** partner with the founders on technical due diligence for fundraising conversations and enterprise or regulator pilots.

**REQUIRED SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS**

* 5–8 years of software/ML engineering experience, including at least 2–3 video analytics projects taken from concept to live production.
* Prior experience in kitchen, utility, industrial, or environmental-safety monitoring domains strongly preferred — especially wastage tracking, hygiene compliance, or safety KPIs.
* Strong full-stack development ability — modern frontend framework (React or equivalent) and backend (Node.js/Python).
* Hands-on MLOps experience: model packaging, deployment pipelines, and monitoring/alerting for model drift.
* Solid grounding in computer vision fundamentals (object detection, action recognition), even without daily hands-on model training.
* Experience designing multi-tenant SaaS architectures — auth, role-based access, API design, dashboarding.
* Comfortable working with edge-compute devices and video streaming protocols (RTSP, MQTT).

**PREFERRED / NICE-TO-HAVE**

* Working knowledge of AWS or GCP — compute, storage, IoT services, and managed ML platforms.
* Experience with Docker/Kubernetes and CI/CD pipelines.
* Exposure to regulated, compliance-heavy domains such as food safety, healthcare, or utilities.
* Prior 0-to-1 or early-stage startup product-building experience.

DESRI (formerly D. E. Shaw Renewable Investments) is a market-leading owner and operator of renewable energy projects throughout the United States. DESRI is run by a dynamic team with offices located at New York, Denver, Portland, Houston, and Hyderabad (India).

We are looking for a resourceful and driven professional to join DESRI, based out of the firm’s Hyderabad, India office. * Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers
* Strong Python expertise with experience building scalable APIs (REST/gRPC) and production-grade backend systems.

* Experience building lightweight UIs (React, Next.js, TypeScript) and ability to prototype and iterate quickly in ambiguous environments.
* Clear communicator with a strong ownership mindset for production systems (reliability, cost, and user experience) and awareness of evaluation, observability, and AI safety best practices.

title: Delivery Director
description:
We are Two Circles. We are a Sports & Entertainment Marketing business. We grow audiences and revenues by knowing fans best.

Our platforms and services are trusted by over 1,000 clients globally, including the English Premier League, Red Bull, UEFA, VISA, the NFL, Nike and Amazon. We are over 1,000 people, based across 15 offices worldwide, delivering work for sports and entertainment organisations of all shapes and sizes.

India is a long-term commitment for Two Circles. Being here, and succeeding here, is central to how we build a better future for the sports and entertainment industry globally.

Hyderabad is a Two Circles office, not a GCC. Today it's tech-centric, but our ambition is to diversify what we build here over time, growing into a broad Two Circles presence rather than staying confined to technology propositions.

We're looking for a Delivery Director to lead our Hyderabad delivery organisation: a team of around 50 engineers, QA and delivery specialists, and still growing. This is a hands-on leadership role, not a governance role sitting apart from the work. You'll take direct ownership of how delivery runs day to day, build a high-performing team, and set the tone for its spirit.

You'll report to our APAC Managing Director, with a dotted line to our Engineering Directors for Data and for Digital Products & CRM, who hold technical direction for their respective practices. As the most senior Two Circles leader in Hyderabad, you'll also play an important role in our work with BCCI, our most important partner in India.

We want Hyderabad to be known, by 2029, not just for delivering the work, but for shaping it, owning it, and making it better. That means more ownership of outcomes, greater exposure to our clients and their problems, more leaders and careers built from within Hyderabad, and a reputation for ideas, innovation and smart use of AI, all while protecting the spirit and connection that makes Two Circles what it is as we grow. You'll be the person most accountable for getting us there.

Leading the Team and Its Spirit

* Lead, grow and retain the India delivery team, including recruitment, onboarding and development of new team members.
* Co-own the spirit of our Hyderabad office with our HR Lead. You'll treat this as a core part of your job, not something handed off to the HR team. You will be the role model of Two Circles spirit in the office.
* Build an India leadership layer of Engineering Managers, QA leadership and delivery leadership. Embed progression frameworks, career pathways and regular, structured feedback.
* Be a visible, accessible leader in the office. Build strong relationships and encourage the face-to-face collaboration that builds trust and improves delivery.

* Own the software delivery lifecycle across India projects, with consistent processes that drive quality and predictability.
* Oversee QA and release management standards across India builds, aligned with our global standards.
* Stay close to the work: attend key governance forums, review delivery health weekly, and step in when projects need support.
* Partner with our Tech Leads and Engineering Directors to ensure technical standards and architectural approaches are followed and executed well.
* Embed the agentic engineering practices being rolled out across our global teams. Drive adoption in India and share what you learn.
* Help the India team take increasing ownership of outcomes end-to-end, including design, not just execution, and reduce reliance on other regions to unblock problems.

Performance, Metrics and Governance

* Create and run a monthly governance process and health report for the India team, covering hiring, onboarding, attrition, utilisation, quality, performance and progress on major initiatives.
* Own delivery, quality and team health metrics, including code quality, production defects and time to resolve issues. Track how project leaders elsewhere in the business rate the India team's work.
* Own utilisation and cost efficiency across India delivery. Propose the India hiring plan and work with Delivery Directors globally on resource planning and hotspots.
* Keep any scorecard or metrics simple and supportive, not a tool that creates pressure. Psychological safety and performance measurement need to be built together, not treated as separate things.

Client Leadership

* Act as Client Lead for BCCI: our most senior relationship owner in India, accountable for client governance and margin efficiency. We'd expect this to take up roughly 10% of your time.
* Represent our engineering and delivery capability in client meetings in India, drawing on the work we deliver globally.

Global Collaboration

* Give leadership upward visibility, and give teams clarity on priorities, outcomes and decisions.
* Work with Directors in Melbourne, London and Vancouver to develop operating models that let teams work smoothly across regions.
* Help Hyderabad become a knowledge hub, not just a delivery team: bring in what's working well from London, Melbourne and Vancouver, and feed Hyderabad's own innovations back out to the rest of the business.
* Work effectively across time zones and cultures, bringing structure and clarity to complex, global work.

* A high-performing team, shown in hard metrics such as code quality, production defects and time to resolve issues, and in strong feedback from the project leaders the team works with across regions.
* A strong spirit in our Hyderabad office, measured against our regular pulse checks.
* Our agentic engineering practices widely adopted across the India team.
* A clear monthly view of the India team's health, shared with the wider business through a regular governance process.
* An India leadership layer in place that can support continued growth.

  
**Requirements**

Proven experience building, scaling and leading complex delivery organisations at scale (50+ people) spanning engineering, QA and delivery, including experience managing managers.

* A delivery and operator mindset first. Genuine fluency across data and digital product engineering, sufficient to work credibly with Tech Leads and architects on trade-offs, quality and risk, without requiring a hands-on engineering background yourself.
* Senior client-facing experience in a services, agency or consultancy business.
* Experience working within a multi-region or global delivery model.
* Hands-on ownership of the software delivery lifecycle, delivery processes, resourcing and talent management.
* A demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders without formal authority, across technical, commercial and client audiences.
* An interest in AI-enabled development practices and the drive to lead their adoption.
* Fluent in English, written and spoken.
* Eligible to work in India.

Nice to Have

* A formal delivery or PMO background, or certification (Scrum, PRINCE2 or equivalent).
* Familiarity with the platforms we build on (CMS, identity, video, CRM and e-commerce) and modern cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure or Google Cloud.

Location and Travel

Based in Hyderabad or willing to relocate to Hyderabad.

Able to travel to Vancouver, London, and Melbourne twice a year.

**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS OWNED BY THIS ROLE**

* Cost per transaction and productivity per FTE against the operating plan
* Training and certification: nesting graduation rate, time\-to\-proficiency for new hires, cross\-skilling coverage %
